name: @theorionic/mcp-acp-bridge

tools.name: initialize_client
tools.description: Initialize a new ACP agent connection. Supported agents: gemini, opencode. You can pass custom arguments like --model. Set toolApprovalMode to "manual" to hold tool call permissions for explicit approval via approve_tool_call.

agent.description: The preconfigured agent to connect to.

connectionId.description: A unique identifier for this connection (e.g., 'task-1').

cwd.description: Working directory for the agent. Overrides the default agent directory.

extraArgs.description: Extra arguments to pass to the agent command (e.g., ['--model', 'gemini-2.0-flash']).

env.description: Environment variables for the agent process.

toolApprovalMode.description: Tool approval mode. "auto" (default) approves all tool calls automatically. "manual" holds permission requests for explicit approval via approve_tool_call.

tools.name: send_prompt
tools.description: Send a prompt to a specific connected agent. Use preserveHistory=true for multi-turn conversations without losing prior response context.

connectionId.description: The ID of the connection to send the prompt to.

mode.description: Wait: block until finished. Poll: start and return immediately. Interrupt: stop current generation and send new prompt.

preserveHistory.description: If true, append to existing response buffer instead of clearing it. Use for multi-turn conversations where you need prior context. Default: false.

tools.name: read_response
tools.description: Read the response from a specific agent. Supports incremental reads (only new content since last read) and detailed tool call information.

connectionId.description: The ID of the connection to read from.

mode.description: Wait: block until any active generation completes. Poll: return current snapshot immediately.

sinceLastRead.description: If true, only return content that has been added since the last read_response call (incremental mode). Default: false (return full buffer).

includeToolDetails.description: If true, include detailed tool call information (tool name, status, content) instead of just log summaries. Default: false.

tools.name: approve_tool_call
tools.description: Approve or deny a pending tool call permission request from an agent (only applicable when toolApprovalMode is 'manual'). List pending requests first, then approve/deny by requestId.

requestId.description: The ID of the pending permission request to approve/deny.

action.description: approve: allow the tool call. deny: cancel the tool call.

optionIndex.description: When approving, the index of the option to select (default: 0, typically 'allow'). Use list_connections to see available options.

tools.name: reset_session
tools.description: Reset the agent session on an existing connection. Clears conversation history and response buffers without restarting the agent process. Much faster than closing and re-initializing.

connectionId.description: The ID of the connection to reset.

cwd.description: Optional new working directory for the reset session.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List all active ACP agent connections with their status, pending permissions, and tool call summaries.

tools.name: close_connection
tools.description: Close an active ACP connection and terminate the underlying process.

connectionId.description: The ID of the connection to terminate.
